    Profile

    Strie was born in a poor village in the Desert Zone. She spends her days full of excitement, stealing from bad guys and gambling. On the other hand, there's also a kind side to her. She wants to use this money to save her fellow villagers.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 161cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Apr 8
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Treasures
    Hobbies: Gambling
    Illust: やもり
    CV: 遠藤綾
